# The review of milestone 4d: the path rules a movie and a root folder
# share with the recycling bin and the system folders, and two answers
# the review found worded otherwise. A recording of its own; same format.
#
#   GOLDEN_REQUESTS=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-review/requests.txt \
#       GOLDEN_OUT=tests/fixtures/radarr/golden-review make golden-radarr
#
# The original reaches api.radarr.video through scripts/mock-servarr.py,
# which becomes its HTTP proxy here, as in golden-library's recording: the
# movies the requests name are answered from tests/fixtures/metadata, not
# by the real server.
config-host GET /api/v3/config/host
config-host-put-proxy PUT /api/v3/config/host/1 bodies/config-host-proxy.json
sleep 8

# A recycling bin that exists, set for what follows.
mock - POST /mock/fs/write?path=/downloads/bin/kept/Some.Movie.2020.1080p.WEB-DL.x264-GRP.mkv&clip=episode
config-mediamanagement GET /api/v3/config/mediamanagement
config-mediamanagement-put-bin PUT /api/v3/config/mediamanagement/1 bodies/config-mediamanagement-put-bin.json

# `MovieController`: a movie's path is not the bin, nor inside it, nor a
# system folder or inside one.
movie-add-path-is-bin POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-path-is-bin.json
movie-add-path-in-bin POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-path-in-bin.json
movie-add-path-in-system-folder POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-path-in-system-folder.json
movie-add-path-is-system-folder POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-path-is-system-folder.json
# The same folders spelled with `..`, `.` and repeated slashes.
movie-add-path-dotted-system-folder POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-path-dotted-system-folder.json
movie-add-path-dotted-bin POST /api/v3/movie bodies/movie-add-path-dotted-bin.json
movie-6 GET /api/v3/movie/6
movie-put-path-in-bin PUT /api/v3/movie/6 bodies/movie-put-path-in-bin.json
movie-put-path-in-system-folder PUT /api/v3/movie/6 bodies/movie-put-path-in-system-folder.json

# `AddMovieValidator`, which the library import goes through: the bin,
# and a movie that names neither a path nor a root folder.
movie-import-path-in-bin POST /api/v3/movie/import bodies/movie-import-path-in-bin.json
movie-import-blank-root POST /api/v3/movie/import bodies/movie-import-blank-root.json
movie-import-no-root POST /api/v3/movie/import bodies/movie-import-no-root.json
# A root folder sent with a space in front: Path.Combine keeps it.
movie-import-spaced-root POST /api/v3/movie/import bodies/movie-import-spaced-root.json
movie-after-imports GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=157336

# `RootFolderController`: a root folder is not the bin, nor inside it,
# nor a system folder.
rootfolder-create-is-bin POST /api/v3/rootfolder bodies/rootfolder-create-is-bin.json
rootfolder-create-in-bin POST /api/v3/rootfolder bodies/rootfolder-create-in-bin.json
rootfolder-create-system-folder POST /api/v3/rootfolder bodies/rootfolder-create-system-folder.json
rootfolder-create-double-slash POST /api/v3/rootfolder bodies/rootfolder-create-double-slash.json
# A folder the bin is inside of is no concern of the bin's rule.
rootfolder-create-above-bin POST /api/v3/rootfolder bodies/rootfolder-create-above-bin.json
rootfolder-after GET /api/v3/rootfolder

# A filter with no value.
blocklist-movie-ids-empty GET /api/v3/blocklist?page=1&pageSize=5&movieIds=
blocklist-movie-ids-space GET /api/v3/blocklist?page=1&pageSize=5&movieIds=%20
blocklist-protocols-space GET /api/v3/blocklist?page=1&pageSize=5&protocols=%20

# Discover adds what validates and leaves out a movie TMDB does not know
# (`AddMovies(movies, true)`).
importlist-movie-add-one-unknown POST /api/v3/importlist/movie bodies/importlist-movie-add-one-unknown.json
sleep 10
movie-added-from-discover GET /api/v3/movie?tmdbId=157336

config-mediamanagement-restore PUT /api/v3/config/mediamanagement/1 bodies/config-mediamanagement-restore.json
